<title>Dazvol | RoadPermit</title>
<style>

*{box-sizing:border-box;letter-spacing:0}body{margin:0;font:15px/1.5 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",sans-serif;color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg)}button,input,select{font:inherit}button,a,input,select,summary{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}button{cursor:pointer}button:disabled{cursor:default;opacity:.5}button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,summary:focus-visible{outline:3px .16s}button:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px)}[hidden]{display:none!important}a{color:var(--blue)}.header{background:#ffffffeb;border-bottom:1px solid input[type=number],select{border:1px solid #cbd8e1;border-radius:6px;padding:10px summary{cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;color:#486575;font-weight:600}.condition-list{display:grid;gap:12px;padding-top:12px;max-width:850px}.actions{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;border-top:1px 1fr;gap:18px}.statusbar.red{border-left-color:var(--red)}.statusbar.amber{border-left-color:#d49b21}.status-label{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:6px}.status-value{font-weight:700;font-size:17px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.status-value.good{color:var(--teal)}.status-value.warn{color:var(--amber)}.status-value.bad{color:var(--red)}.type-name{font-size:15px;font-weight:600}.fee-table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;background:white;margin-top:18px;font-size:14px}.fee-table 0;display:grid;gap:9px;font-size:13px;color:#536b7a}.notes li{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px}.notes li span:first-child{flex-shrink:0}.aside{border-left:1px solid var(--line);padding-left:24px;min-width:0}.aside dl{margin:0;display:grid;gap:15px}.aside dt{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:3px}.aside .source{font-size:12px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:25px;padding-top:15px;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.source p{margin:7px 0}.exceptions{border-top:1px solid var(--line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:14px 0;margin-top:20px}.exceptions summary{font-weight:650;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer}.exceptions ol{padding-left:23px;font-size:13px;color:#465e6c;display:grid;gap:9px}.exceptions .sub{margin-top:12px;font-size:12px}.foot{margin-top:28px;padding:18px 0;border-top:1px solid p{max-width:800px}.toast{position:fixed;bottom:25px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#173d4f;color:white;padding:10px 20px;border-radius:6px;z-index:50;font-size:13px}.progress-icon{display:inline-block}.busy .progress-icon{animation:spin .6s linear infinite}@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}@keyframes appear{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media(min-width:1500px){main{padding-top:45px}}@media(max-width:850px){.country-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 36px minmax(0,1fr)}.country-grid>.field:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}.result-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.aside{border-left:0;padding:20px 0 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)}.aside dl{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.aside .source{margin-top:18px}.header-inner{min-height:70px}.brand small{display:none}}@media(max-width:540px){.header-inner{padding:12px 16px;gap:10px}.brand{gap:8px}.brand strong{font-size:18px}.brandmark{width:35px;height:35px;font-size:22px}.langs button{padding:6px 9px;font-size:12px}main{padding:24px 16px 12px}h1{font-size:25px}.heading{align-items:flex-start;gap:9px}.year{font-size:10px;padding:5px 7px}.workspace{padding:20px 15px}.section-line{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column}.section-line h2{font-size:17px}.mode,.mode select{width:100%}.country-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:13px}.country-grid>.field:last-child{grid-column:auto}.swap{display:none}.input-shell{min-height:50px}.extra-fields{grid-template-columns:1fr}.actions{justify-content:space-between;gap:6px}.btn{padding:10px 14px}.btn.primary{min-width:150px;flex:1}.result-heading h2{font-size:18px}.statusbar{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:16px;gap:14px}.statusbar>div+div{border-top:1px solid var(--line);padding-top:13px}.fee-table td,.fee-table th{padding:11px 10px}.fee-table{font-size:12px}.total{padding:15px 12px}.total strong{font-size:22px}.aside dl{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}.foot{flex-direction:column;gap:8px}.route-strip{font-size:12px}.result-tools .icon-button{width:32px;height:34px}.status-value{font-size:16px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*::before,*::after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important}}
@media print{body{background:white;font-size:12px}.header,.workspace,.heading,.result-tools,.foot,.toast{display:none!important}main{padding:0;max-width:none}.result{margin:0}.result-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.aside{border:0;padding:0}.aside dl{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.exceptions{break-inside:avoid}.fee-table,.statusbar,.total{break-inside:avoid}.notes{font-size:11px}}
.government-bar{background:#124d80;color:#fff;font-size:11px}.government-inner{max-width:1200px;padding:8px 28px;margin:auto;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px}.government-inner span:first-child{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}.government-inner img{width:22px;height:14px}.header-inner{min-height:112px}.brandmark{width:67px;height:68px;background:none;border-radius:0}.brandmark img{width:64px;height:66px;object-fit:contain}.brand strong{font-size:19px;display:block;max-width:410px}.brand small{font-size:12px;margin-top:4px}.header-tools{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:24px}.ministry-link{border-right:1px solid var(--line);padding-right:22px;display:block}.ministry-link img{width:58px;height:58px;object-fit:contain}.header{border-bottom:3px solid #1c8873}.heading{align-items:flex-start;margin-bottom:27px}.heading h1{max-width:950px;font-size:32px;line-height:1.3}.heading .sub{margin-top:12px}.workspace{box-shadow:0 3px 20px #203c4d08;border-top:0;border:1px solid #d7e1e8}.btn.primary{background:#125a91;border-color:#125a91}.pdf-button{min-height:40px;padding:8px 13px;background:#125a91;color:white;border:0;font-size:13px;white-space:nowrap}.result-heading{flex-wrap:wrap}.result-tools{align-items:center}.result-tools .icon-button{height:40px}.service-name{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);max-width:220px}.report-preview{display:none}
@media(max-width:850px){.brand small{display:block}.header-inner{min-height:100px}.brand strong{font-size:17px}.heading h1{font-size:29px}.ministry-link{display:none}.header-tools{gap:0}}
@media(max-width:540px){.government-inner{padding:7px 16px;font-size:10px}.government-inner>span:last-child{max-width:140px;text-align:right}.header-inner{padding:15px 16px;align-items:flex-start;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}.brand{flex:1;min-width:200px}.brand strong{font-size:15px;line-height:1.4}.brand small{font-size:10px;max-width:220px}.brandmark{width:45px;height:48px;flex-shrink:0}.brandmark img{width:44px;height:46px}.header-tools{margin-left:auto}.heading{display:block}.heading h1{font-size:24px;line-height:1.3}.year{display:inline-block;margin-top:14px}.heading .sub{font-size:13px}.result-heading{align-items:flex-start}.result-tools{width:100%}.pdf-button{flex:1}.foot .service-name{max-width:none}}
@media print{.government-bar{display:none!important}}

<body>
<div class="government-bar"><div class="government-inner"><span><img id="national-flag" alt=""><span data-i18n="republic"></span></span><span data-i18n="serviceKind"></span></div></div>
<header class="header"><div class="header-inner"><div class="brand"><span class="brandmark"><img id="state-emblem" alt=""></span><div><strong data-i18n="brandName"></strong><small data-i18n="brandSub"></small></div></div><div class="header-tools"><a class="ministry-link" href="https://gov.uz/oz/mintrans" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" id="ministry-link"><img id="ministry-emblem" alt=""></a><nav class="langs" aria-label="Language"><button type="button" data-lang="uz">UZ</button><button type="button" data-lang="ru">RU</button><button type="button" data-lang="en">EN</button></nav></div></div></header>
<main>
<div class="heading"><div><h1 data-i18n="title"></h1><p class="sub" data-i18n="subtitle"></p></div><span class="year" data-i18n="year"></span></div>
<form id="checker" class="workspace" novalidate>
<div class="section-line"><h2><span class="step">1</span><span data-i18n="route"></span></h2><div class="mode"><select id="mode" aria-label="Transport mode"><option value="cargo" data-i18n="cargo"></option><option value="7" data-i18n="emptyEntry"></option><option value="8" data-i18n="emptyTransit"></option></select></div></div>
<div class="country-grid">
<div class="field"><label for="origin"><span class="label-emoji">📍</span><span data-i18n="origin"></span></label><div class="combo" data-field="origin"><div class="input-shell"><span class="selected-flag"></span><input id="origin" autocomplete="off" role="combobox" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="origin-list"><button type="button" class="clear" data-clear="origin">×</button></div><div class="options" id="origin-list" role="listbox" hidden></div></div></div>
<button type="button" class="icon-button swap" id="swap">⇄</button>
<div class="field"><label for="destination"><span class="label-emoji">🏁</span><span data-i18n="destination"></span></label><div class="combo" data-field="destination"><div class="input-shell"><span class="selected-flag"></span><input id="destination" autocomplete="off" role="combobox" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="destination-list"><button type="button" class="clear" data-clear="destination">×</button></div><div class="options" id="destination-list" role="listbox" hidden></div></div></div>
<div class="field"><label for="vehicle"><span class="label-emoji">🚚</span><span data-i18n="vehicle"></span></label><div class="combo" data-field="vehicle"><div class="input-shell"><span class="selected-flag"></span><input id="vehicle" autocomplete="off" role="combobox" aria-autocomplete="list" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="vehicle-list"><button type="button" class="clear" data-clear="vehicle">×</button></div><div class="options" id="vehicle-list" role="listbox" hidden></div></div></div>
</div>
<div class="route-strip" id="route-strip" hidden></div>
<label class="checkline transit" id="transit-line" hidden><input type="checkbox" id="via" checked><span data-i18n="viaUz"></span></label>
<div class="details-line"><h3><span class="step">2</span><span data-i18n="conditions"></span></h3>
<div class="extra-fields" id="extra-fields" hidden><div class="field" id="weight-field" hidden><label for="weight" data-i18n="capacity"></label><input id="weight" type="number" min="0.01" max="1000" step="0.01" inputmode="decimal" value="20"><p class="hint" data-i18n="capacityHint"></p></div><div class="field" id="days-field" hidden><label for="days" data-i18n="days"></label><input id="days" type="number" min="1" max="3660" step="1" inputmode="numeric" value="14"><p class="hint" data-i18n="daysHint"></p></div></div>
<div class="conditions"><label class="checkline" id="human-line"><input id="humanitarian" type="checkbox"><span data-i18n="humanitarian"></span></label><label class="checkline"><input id="heavy" type="checkbox"><span data-i18n="heavy"></span></label><details><summary data-i18n="special"></summary><div class="condition-list"><label class="checkline"><input id="purchase" type="checkbox"><span data-i18n="purchase"></span></label></div></details></div></div>
<div class="error" id="error" role="alert" hidden></div>
<div class="actions"><button class="btn quiet" id="reset" type="button"><span aria-hidden="true">↺</span><span data-i18n="reset"></span></button><button class="btn primary" type="submit" id="calculate"><span class="progress-icon" aria-hidden="true">⌕</span><span data-i18n="check"></span></button></div>
</form>
<section id="result" class="result" aria-live="polite" hidden></section>
<footer class="foot"><p><span data-i18n="disclaimer"></span> <span data-i18n="independent"></span></p><span class="service-name" data-i18n="serviceKind"></span></footer>
</main><div id="toast" class="toast" role="status" hidden></div>
<script>
'use strict';
const DATA={"countries":{"100":"БОЛГАРИЯ","104":"МЬЯНМА","108":"БУРУНДИ","112":"БЕЛОРУССИЯ","116":"КАМБОДЖА","120":"КАМЕРУН","124":"КАНАДА","132":"КАБО - ВЕРДЕ","136":"КАЙМАН","140":"ЦЕНТР. -  АФР. Please try again.",report:"VERIFICATION SUMMARY",reportSub:"Summary of permit requirements and calculated fees",reportNotes:"Important notes",reportConditions:"Calculation conditions",reportExceptions:"Number of matching exceptions",reportExceptionNote:"The full exceptions are available in the HTML application result; no exemption was applied automatically.",reportOriginal:"The complete additional conditions and notes remain available in the check result.",yes:"Yes",no:"No",page:"1 / 1"});
const STAY_COUNTRIES=new Set('031 040 056 100 191 196 203 208 233 246 250 276 300 348 372 380 428 440 442 470 528 616 620 642 703 705 724 752'.split(' '));
const state={lang:'uz',selected:{origin:null,destination:null,vehicle:null},result:null};
try{const stored=localStorage.getItem('roadpermit-language');if(TEXT[stored])state.lang=stored}catch{}
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),t=key=>TEXT[state.lang][key]||key;
const escapeHTML=s=>String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"']/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;',"'":'&#39;'}[c]));
function countryName(code,lang=state.lang){if(code==='000')return TEXT[lang].other;return DATA.names[lang]?.[code]||DATA.countries[code]||code}
function flag(code){const iso=DATA.iso[code],src=DATA.flags[iso];return src?`<img class="flag" src="${src}" alt="" width="25" height="17">`:'<span class="flag-fallback" aria-hidden="true">🌐</span>'}
function normalize(s){return String(s).toLowerCase().normalize('NFKD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f'’‘ʻʼ`]/g,'').replace(/ё/g,'е').replace(/[^a-zа-я0-9]/g,'')}
function distance(a,b){const row=Array.from({length:b.length+1},(_,i)=>i);for(let i=1;i<=a.length;i++){let prev=row[0];row[0]=i;for(let j=1;j<=b.length;j++){const old=row[j];row[j]=Math.min(row[j]+1,row[j-1]+1,prev+(a[i-1]!==b[j-1]));prev=old}}return row[b.length]}
const searchIndex=Object.keys(DATA.countries).map(code=>({code,terms:[code,String(Number(code)),DATA.iso[code]||'',DATA.countries[code],...['uz','ru','en'].map(l=>countryName(code,l)),...(DATA.aliases[code]||[])].map(normalize).filter(Boolean)}));
function searchCountries(query){const q=normalize(query);if(!q){const popular=['860','398','156','643','417','762','795','004','031','276','792','364'];return [...popular,...Object.keys(DATA.countries).filter(c=>!popular.includes(c)).sort((a,b)=>countryName(a).localeCompare(countryName(b),state.lang))]}return searchIndex.map(row=>({code:row.code,score:Math.max(...row.terms.map(term=>term===q?3:term.startsWith(q)?2:term.includes(q)&&q.length>=3?1.4:q.length>=3?1-distance(q,term)/Math.max(q.length,term.length):0))})).filter(r=>r.score>=.75).sort((a,b)=>b.score-a.score||countryName(a.code).localeCompare(countryName(b.code),state.lang)).map(r=>r.code)}
function classify(o,d,v,mode='cargo'){if(mode==='7'||mode==='8')return Number(mode);if(o==='860'&&d==='860')return 6;if(o==='860')return v===d?1:4;if(d==='860')return v===o?2:5;return 3}
function rateKind(v,rule){if(rule?.d!=='1'||v==='860'||v==='364')return 'none';const a=String(rule.amount||'').trim();if(a&&!a.includes('/')&&/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(a))return 'fixed';if(v==='762'||v==='795')return 'weight';if(STAY_COUNTRIES.has(v))return 'days';return 'fixed'}
function schedule(v,weight,days,rule){if(v==='364')return {amount:0,reason:'iran'};const raw=String(rule.amount||'').trim();if(raw&&!raw.includes('/')){if(!/^\d+(\.\d+)?$/.test(raw))return {amount:null,reason:'unknown'};return {amount:Number(raw),reason:'custom'}}if(v==='762'||v==='795'){const tier=weight<=10?'up_to_10':weight<=20?'from_10_to_20':'over_20';return {amount:DATA.fees[v==='762'?'tajikistan_by_weight_usd':'turkmenistan_by_weight_usd'][tier],reason:'tierWeight'}}if(STAY_COUNTRIES.has(v))return {amount:days<=14?80:280,reason:'tierDays'};const special={'004':50,'398':300,'417':300};return {amount:special[v]??400,reason:'defaultRate'}}
function calculate(input){const {origin:o,destination:d,vehicle:v,mode='cargo',via=true,weight=20,days=14,humanitarian=false,heavy=false,purchase=false}=input;
if(![o,d,v].every(c=>Object.hasOwn(DATA.countries,c)))return {error:'select'};
if(mode==='cargo'&&v==='000'&&((o==='000'&&d==='860')||(o==='860'&&d==='000')||(o==='000'&&d==='000')))return {error:'unknownRelation'};
if(o===d&&d===v&&o!=='860'&&o!=='000')return {error:'same'};
if(mode==='7'&&(d!=='860'||o==='860')||mode==='8'&&(o==='860'||d==='860'))return {error:'emptyInvalid'};
const type=classify(o,d,v,mode);if((type===3||type===8)&&!via)return {error:'noUz'};
const rule=DATA.rules[v]?.[String(type)]||null,kind=rateKind(v,rule);
if(kind==='weight'&&(!Number.isFinite(weight)||weight<=0||weight>1000))return {error:'badWeight'};
if(kind==='days'&&(!Number.isInteger(days)||days<1||days>3660))return {error:'badDays'};
const r={input:{...input},type,rule,kind,base:null,baseBefore:null,extra:0,purchase:0,reason:null,notes:[],unknown:false,blocked:rule?.p==='3',timestamp:new Date().toISOString()};
if(!rule){r.unknown=true;r.notes.push('ruleMissing')}
if(r.blocked){r.notes.push('blocked');return r}
if(v==='860'){r.base=0;r.notes.push('national')}
else if(rule?.d==='2'){r.base=0}
else if(rule?.d==='1'){const rate=schedule(v,weight,days,rule);r.base=rate.amount;r.reason=rate.reason;if(r.base===null)r.unknown=true}
else{r.unknown=true;r.notes.push(rule?.d==='3'?'dependent':'unresolved')}
if(v==='795'&&mode==='cargo'&&((o==='860'&&d!=='860')||(d==='860'&&o!=='860'&&o!=='795')))r.extra=375;
if(humanitarian&&r.base>0&&mode==='cargo'){r.baseBefore=r.base;r.base=Math.round(r.base*.5*100)/100;if(r.extra)r.notes.push('humanExtra')}
if(kind==='days')r.notes.push(r.baseBefore!==null?'stayHuman':'stayNote');if(heavy)r.notes.push('heavyNote');if(v==='000')r.notes.push('otherNote');
if(purchase&&v!=='860'){r.purchase=type===3||type===8?200:type===4||type===5?800:400;r.notes.push('purchaseNote')}else if(purchase)r.notes.push('purchaseIgnored');
if(rule?.manual)r.notes.push('manual');if(rule?.inferred)r.notes.unshift('inferred');r.total=(r.base??0)+r.extra+r.purchase;return r}
window.DazvolEngine={calculate,classify,searchCountries,rateKind,data:DATA};
const combos={};
for(const field of ['origin','destination','vehicle']){
 const input=$(field),list=$(field+'-list'),shell=input.closest('.combo');const combo={input,list,shell,items:[],active:-1};combos[field]=combo;
 function open(query=''){closeLists(field);combo.items=searchCountries(query);combo.active=-1;list.innerHTML=combo.items.length?combo.items.map((code,i)=>`<button type="button" role="option" aria-selected="false" class="option" id="${field}-opt-${i}" data-code="${code}">${flag(code)}<span class="name">${escapeHTML(countryName(code))}</span><span class="code">${code}</span></button>`).join(''):`<p class="empty-search">${escapeHTML(t('noMatches'))}</p>`;list.hidden=false;input.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');input.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant')}
 input.addEventListener('focus',()=>open(state.selected[field]?'':input.value));input.addEventListener('input',()=>{state.selected[field]=null;updateFlag(field);invalidate();updateConditions();open(input.value)});
 input.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{if(event.key==='Escape'){closeLists();return}if(event.key==='ArrowDown'||event.key==='ArrowUp'){event.preventDefault();if(list.hidden)open(input.value);if(!combo.items.length)return;combo.active=(combo.active+(event.key==='ArrowDown'?1:-1)+combo.items.length)%combo.items.length;list.querySelectorAll('.option').forEach((el,i)=>{el.classList.toggle('active',i===combo.active);el.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(i===combo.active))});const active=$(field+'-opt-'+combo.active);input.setAttribute('aria-activedescendant',active.id);active.scrollIntoView({block:'nearest'})}if(event.key==='Enter'&&!list.hidden){event.preventDefault();if(combo.active>=0)selectCountry(field,combo.items[combo.active])}});
 list.addEventListener('mousedown',event=>event.preventDefault());list.addEventListener('click',event=>{const option=event.target.closest('[data-code]');if(option)selectCountry(field,option.dataset.code)});
 shell.addEventListener('focusout',()=>setTimeout(()=>{if(!shell.contains(document.activeElement)){list.hidden=true;input.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false')}},0));
}
function closeLists(except){for(const [key,c]of Object.entries(combos)){if(key!==except){c.list.hidden=true;c.input.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');c.input.removeAttribute('aria-activedescendant')}}}
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(!e.target.closest('.combo'))closeLists()});
function updateFlag(field){const c=state.selected[field];combos[field].shell.querySelector('.selected-flag').innerHTML=c?flag(c):'<span class="flag-fallback" aria-hidden="true">🌐</span>'}
function selectCountry(field,code){state.selected[field]=code;$(field).value=countryName(code);updateFlag(field);closeLists();invalidate();updateConditions()}
function invalidate(){state.result=null;$('result').hidden=true;$('error').hidden=true}
function updateConditions(){const {origin:o,destination:d,vehicle:v}=state.selected,mode=$('mode').value;const type=o&&d&&v?classify(o,d,v,mode):null,rule=DATA.rules[v]?.[String(type)],kind=rateKind(v,rule);$('weight-field').hidden=kind!=='weight';$('days-field').hidden=kind!=='days';$('extra-fields').hidden=!['weight','days'].includes(kind);$('transit-line').hidden=!(o&&d&&o!=='860'&&d!=='860');$('human-line').hidden=mode!=='cargo';if(mode!=='cargo')$('humanitarian').checked=false;const strip=$('route-strip');strip.hidden=!(o&&d);if(o&&d)strip.innerHTML=`${flag(o)}<span>${escapeHTML(countryName(o))}</span><span class="route-arrow">→</span>${o!=='860'&&d!=='860'?`${flag('860')}<span>${escapeHTML(countryName('860'))}</span><span class="route-arrow">→</span>`:''}${flag(d)}<span>${escapeHTML(countryName(d))}</span>${type?`<span style="margin-left:auto;font-weight:600">${escapeHTML(TEXT[state.lang].types[type])}</span>`:''}`}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-clear]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>{const f=b.dataset.clear;state.selected[f]=null;$(f).value='';updateFlag(f);invalidate();updateConditions();$(f).focus()}));
$('swap').addEventListener('click',()=>{[state.selected.origin,state.selected.destination]=[state.selected.destination,state.selected.origin];for(const f of ['origin','destination']){$(f).value=state.selected[f]?countryName(state.selected[f]):'';updateFlag(f)}invalidate();updateConditions()});
for(const id of ['mode','via','weight','days','humanitarian','heavy','purchase'])$(id).addEventListener('input',()=>{invalidate();updateConditions()});
$('reset').addEventListener('click',()=>{HTMLFormElement.prototype.reset.call($('checker'));for(const f of Object.keys(combos)){state.selected[f]=null;$(f).value='';updateFlag(f)}invalidate();closeLists();updateConditions();$('origin').focus()});
function money(n){return new Intl.NumberFormat(state.lang==='uz'?'uz-UZ':state.lang==='ru'?'ru-RU':'en-US',{maximumFractionDigits:2}).format(n)+' USD'}
function note(key,style=''){return `<div class="notice ${style}">${escapeHTML(t(key))}</div>`}
function renderResult(r){const rule=r.rule,p=rule?.p,permit=p==='1'?['⚠️','required','warn']:p==='2'?['✅','notRequired','good']:p==='3'?['⛔','prohibited','bad']:['❔','unknown','warn'];let rows='';
 const row=(label,value,sub='')=>`<tr><td>${escapeHTML(label)}${sub?`<small>${escapeHTML(sub)}</small>`:''}</td><td>${escapeHTML(value)}</td></tr>`;
 if(!r.blocked){rows+=row(t('base'),r.base===null?t('unknown'):r.base===0?t('noFee'):money(r.baseBefore??r.base),r.reason?t(r.reason):'');if(r.baseBefore!==null)rows+=row(t('discount'),'−'+money(r.baseBefore-r.base));if(r.extra)rows+=row(t('extra'),money(r.extra));if(r.purchase)rows+=row(t('permitSale'),money(r.purchase))}
 const exceptions=(DATA.exceptions[r.input.vehicle]||[]).filter(e=>e.mask[r.type-1]==='1');
 const noteHtml=r.notes.map(k=>note(k,['national','purchaseNote','manual','otherNote'].includes(k)?'info':'')).join('');
 const feeTable=!r.blocked?`<table class="fee-table"><thead><tr><th>${escapeHTML(t('feeName'))}</th><th>${escapeHTML(t('amount'))}</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows}</tbody></table><div class="total"><span>${escapeHTML(t(r.unknown?'knownTotal':'total'))}</span><strong>${money(r.total)}</strong></div>`:'';
 const exHtml=!r.blocked&&exceptions.length?`<details class="exceptions"><summary>📋 ${escapeHTML(t('exceptionTitle'))} (${exceptions.length})</summary><p class="sub">${escapeHTML(t('original'))}</p><ol>${exceptions.map(e=>`<li>${escapeHTML(e.text)}</li>`).join('')}</ol></details>`:!r.blocked&&rule?.exception==='2'?note('exceptionMissing','info'):'';
 const notes=rule?.notes?.[state.lang]||'';
 $('result').innerHTML=`<div class="result-heading"><h2>📋 ${escapeHTML(t('result'))}</h2><div class="result-tools"><button type="button" class="icon-button" id="copy" title="${escapeHTML(t('copy'))}" aria-label="${escapeHTML(t('copy'))}">⧉</button><button type="button" class="icon-button" id="print" title="${escapeHTML(t('print'))}" aria-label="${escapeHTML(t('print'))}">⎙</button></div></div><div class="result-grid"><div class="result-main"><div class="statusbar ${r.blocked?'red':p==='1'||r.unknown?'amber':''}"><div><div class="status-label">${escapeHTML(t('permit'))}</div><div class="status-value ${permit[2]}">${permit[0]} ${escapeHTML(t(permit[1]))}</div></div><div><div class="status-label">${escapeHTML(t('type'))}</div><div class="type-name">${escapeHTML(TEXT[state.lang].types[r.type])}</div></div></div>${feeTable}${noteHtml}${notes?`<div class="notice info">${escapeHTML(notes)}</div>`:''}${exHtml}</div><aside class="aside"><h3>${escapeHTML(t('route'))}</h3><dl>${['origin','destination','vehicle'].map(f=>`<div><dt>${escapeHTML(t(f))}</dt><dd>${flag(r.input[f])}${escapeHTML(countryName(r.input[f]))} <span class="sub">${r.input[f]}</span></dd></div>`).join('')}${r.kind==='weight'?`<div><dt>${escapeHTML(t('capacity'))}</dt><dd>${r.input.weight}</dd></div>`:''}${r.kind==='days'?`<div><dt>${escapeHTML(t('days'))}</dt><dd>${r.input.days}</dd></div>`:''}</dl><div class="source"><strong>${escapeHTML(t('source'))}</strong><p>${escapeHTML(t('ruleSource'))}<br>${escapeHTML(t('snapshot'))}: ${DATA.sourceDate}</p><p><a href="${DATA.law}" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">${escapeHTML(t('law'))} ↗</a></p><p>${escapeHTML(t('checked'))}<br>${new Date(r.timestamp).toLocaleString(state.lang==='uz'?'uz-UZ':state.lang==='ru'?'ru-RU':'en-GB')}</p></div></aside></div>`;
 const pdfButton=document.createElement('button');pdfButton.type='button';pdfButton.id='download-pdf';pdfButton.className='btn pdf-button';pdfButton.textContent='↓ '+t('pdf');pdfButton.addEventListener('click',downloadResultPDF);$('result').querySelector('.result-tools').prepend(pdfButton);
 $('result').hidden=false;$('copy').addEventListener('click',copyResult);$('print').addEventListener('click',()=>{const d=$('result').querySelector('details');const was=d?.open;if(d)d.open=true;window.print();if(d)d.open=was});
}
async function copyResult(){try{const text=$('result').innerText;await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);showToast('copied')}catch{showToast('copyFailed')}}
let toastTimer;function showToast(key){$('toast').textContent=t(key);$('toast').hidden=false;clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>$('toast').hidden=true,2500)}
$('checker').addEventListener('submit',e=>{e.preventDefault();closeLists();const input={...state.selected,mode:$('mode').value,via:$('via').checked,weight:Number($('weight').value),days:Number($('days').value),humanitarian:$('humanitarian').checked,heavy:$('heavy').checked,purchase:$('purchase').checked};const r=calculate(input);if(r.error){$('error').textContent=t(r.error);$('error').hidden=false;$('result').hidden=true;return}$('error').hidden=true;state.result=r;renderResult(r);$('result').scrollIntoView({behavior:matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches?'instant':'smooth',block:'start'})});
function setLanguage(lang){
 state.lang=lang;document.documentElement.lang=lang;document.title=t('title');
 try{localStorage.setItem('roadpermit-language',lang)}catch{}
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]').forEach(el=>el.textContent=t(el.dataset.i18n));
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-lang]').forEach(el=>el.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(el.dataset.lang===lang)));
 for(const f of Object.keys(combos)){$(f).placeholder=t('search');if(state.selected[f])$(f).value=countryName(state.selected[f]);updateFlag(f)}
 document.querySelectorAll('[data-clear]').forEach(el=>{el.title=t('clear');el.setAttribute('aria-label',t('clear'))});
 $('state-emblem').src=DATA.emblems.uzbekistan;$('state-emblem').alt=t('emblem');
 $('ministry-emblem').src=DATA.emblems.transport;$('ministry-emblem').alt=t('ministry');$('ministry-link').title=t('ministry');$('national-flag').src=DATA.flags.UZ;
 $('mode').setAttribute('aria-label',t('type'));$('swap').title=t('swap');$('swap').setAttribute('aria-label',t('swap'));closeLists();$('error').hidden=true;updateConditions();if(state.result)renderResult(state.result)
}
document.querySelectorAll('[data-lang]').forEach(el=>el.addEventListener('click',()=>setLanguage(el.dataset.lang)));setLanguage(state.lang);
</script>

<script>'use strict';
// Render at 200 dpi so browser fonts cover Uzbek, Cyrillic and English offline.
async function createResultPDF(result,lang){
 const tr=key=>TEXT[lang][key]||key;
 const format=n=>new Intl.NumberFormat(lang==='ru'?'ru-RU':lang==='uz'?'uz-UZ':'en-US',{maximumFractionDigits:2}).format(n)+' USD';
 const imageFrom=src=>new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const image=new Image();image.onload=()=>resolve(image);image.onerror=reject;image.src=src});
 const emblem=await imageFrom(DATA.emblems.uzbekistan);
 await emblem.decode();
 const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');const scale=2.1;canvas.width=Math.round(794*scale);canvas.height=Math.round(1123*scale);
 const ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');ctx.scale(scale,scale);const left=48,right=746,width=right-left;
 function font(size,bold=false){ctx.font=`${bold?'700':'400'} ${size}px Arial, sans-serif`}
 function wrap(text,maxWidth,size,bold=false){font(size,bold);const lines=[];for(const paragraph of String(text).split('\n')){let line='';for(const word of paragraph.split(/\s+/)){if(!word)continue;const candidate=line?line+' '+word:word;if(ctx.measureText(candidate).width<=maxWidth){line=candidate;continue}if(line){lines.push(line);line=''}if(ctx.measureText(word).width<=maxWidth){line=word;continue}for(const ch of word){if(ctx.measureText(line+ch).width>maxWidth){lines.push(line);line=''}line+=ch}}if(line)lines.push(line)}return lines.length?lines:['']}
 const permitted=result.rule?.p;const permission=tr(permitted==='1'?'required':permitted==='2'?'notRequired':permitted==='3'?'prohibited':'unknown');
 const exceptions=(DATA.exceptions[result.input.vehicle]||[]).filter(e=>e.mask[result.type-1]==='1');
 const rows=[];
 if(!result.blocked){rows.push([tr('base'),result.base===null?tr('unknown'):result.base===0?tr('noFee'):format(result.baseBefore??result.base)]);if(result.baseBefore!==null)rows.push([tr('discount'),'-'+format(result.baseBefore-result.base)]);if(result.extra)rows.push([tr('extra'),format(result.extra)]);if(result.purchase)rows.push([tr('permitSale'),format(result.purchase)])}
 const conditionParts=[];
 if(result.kind==='days')conditionParts.push(tr('days')+': '+result.input.days);
 if(result.kind==='weight')conditionParts.push(tr('capacity')+': '+result.input.weight);
 if(result.input.humanitarian)conditionParts.push(tr('humanitarian'));
 if(result.input.heavy)conditionParts.push(tr('heavy'));
 const notes=[...result.notes.map(tr)];
 if(!result.blocked&&exceptions.length)notes.push(`${tr('reportExceptions')}: ${exceptions.length}. ${tr('reportExceptionNote')}`);
 if(result.rule?.notes?.[lang])notes.push(tr('reportOriginal'));
 if(!result.blocked&&!exceptions.length&&result.rule?.exception==='2')notes.push(tr('exceptionMissing'));
 let contentBottom=0;
 function draw(bodySize){
  ctx.fillStyle='#fff';ctx.fillRect(0,0,794,1123);ctx.textBaseline='top';let y=42;
  ctx.drawImage(emblem,left,y,51,52);ctx.fillStyle='#174b73';font(11,true);ctx.fillText(tr('republic').toUpperCase(),left+67,y+1);
  const heading=wrap(tr('title'),width-70,17,true);heading.forEach((line,i)=>ctx.fillText(line,left+67,y+21+i*21));y+=Math.max(76,heading.length*21+30);
  ctx.fillStyle='#167f73';ctx.fillRect(left,y,width,3);y+=19;
  ctx.fillStyle='#142d3f';font(19,true);ctx.fillText(tr('report'),left,y);y+=28;
  ctx.fillStyle='#697c86';font(11);ctx.fillText(tr('checked')+': '+new Date(result.timestamp).toLocaleString(lang==='ru'?'ru-RU':lang==='uz'?'uz-UZ':'en-GB'),left,y);y+=28;
  function text(value,size=bodySize,color='#263e4e',bold=false,space=7){const lines=wrap(value,width,size,bold);ctx.fillStyle=color;font(size,bold);for(const line of lines){ctx.fillText(line,left,y);y+=size*1.35}y+=space}
  function labelValue(label,value){const lines=wrap(value,width-239,bodySize,true);ctx.fillStyle='#627883';font(bodySize-1);ctx.fillText(label,left,y);ctx.fillStyle='#18394d';font(bodySize,true);lines.forEach((line,i)=>ctx.fillText(line,left+239,y+i*bodySize*1.3));y+=Math.max(1,lines.length)*bodySize*1.3+10}
  for(const field of ['origin','destination','vehicle'])labelValue(tr(field),countryName(result.input[field],lang)+' ('+result.input[field]+')');
  labelValue(tr('type'),TEXT[lang].types[result.type]);
  ctx.fillStyle='#f0f5f8';ctx.fillRect(left,y,width,39);ctx.fillStyle='#516a7b';font(bodySize);ctx.fillText(tr('permit'),left+12,y+12);ctx.fillStyle=result.blocked?'#ae3535':permitted==='2'?'#087563':'#925d0c';font(bodySize,true);ctx.fillText(permission,left+239,y+12);y+=53;
  if(rows.length){ctx.fillStyle='#174b73';ctx.fillRect(left,y,width,29);ctx.fillStyle='white';font(bodySize-1,true);ctx.fillText(tr('feeName'),left+12,y+8);ctx.textAlign='right';ctx.fillText(tr('amount'),right-12,y+8);ctx.textAlign='left';y+=29;
   rows.forEach(([name,amount],index)=>{const lines=wrap(name,width-194,bodySize);const h=lines.length*bodySize*1.3+17;ctx.fillStyle=index%2?'#f1f5f7':'#fafbfc';ctx.fillRect(left,y,width,h);ctx.fillStyle='#253f4e';font(bodySize);lines.forEach((line,i)=>ctx.fillText(line,left+12,y+8+i*bodySize*1.3));ctx.textAlign='right';font(bodySize,true);ctx.fillText(amount,right-12,y+8);ctx.textAlign='left';y+=h});
   ctx.fillStyle='#e4f1ec';ctx.fillRect(left,y,width,43);ctx.fillStyle='#1d594b';font(bodySize,true);ctx.fillText(tr(result.unknown?'knownTotal':'total'),left+12,y+14);ctx.textAlign='right';font(21,true);ctx.fillText(format(result.total),right-12,y+9);ctx.textAlign='left';y+=58;
  }
  if(conditionParts.length)text(tr('reportConditions')+': '+conditionParts.join(' · '),bodySize-1,'#3e6174',false,10);
  if(notes.length){text(tr('reportNotes'),bodySize,'#173f59',true,5);notes.forEach((line,i)=>text((i+1)+'. '+line,bodySize-1,'#3e5260',false,5))}
  y+=3;text(tr('law')+' | '+tr('snapshot')+': '+DATA.sourceDate,11,'#547083',false,2);text(DATA.law,10,'#1a6294',false,0);contentBottom=y;
  const footerTop=1033;ctx.fillStyle='#cbd7df';ctx.fillRect(left,footerTop,width,1);y=1045;text(tr('disclaimer')+' '+tr('independent'),9.2,'#61727c',false,0);ctx.fillStyle='#577383';font(9);ctx.fillText(tr('page'),right-22,1098);
 }
 let size=14;draw(size);while(contentBottom>1014&&size>11){size-=.5;draw(size)}
 if(contentBottom>1014)throw new Error('Summary exceeds one page; refusing to truncate it');
 const pdf=await PDFLib.PDFDocument.create();pdf.setTitle(tr('report'));pdf.setSubject(tr('title'));pdf.setCreator('Offline permit information service');
 const page=pdf.addPage([595.28,841.89]);const png=await pdf.embedPng(canvas.toDataURL('image/png'));page.drawImage(png,{x:0,y:0,width:595.28,height:841.89});
 const bytes=await pdf.save();return {bytes,preview:canvas.toDataURL('image/png'),bodySize:size,contentBottom};
}
async function downloadResultPDF(){
 if(!state.result)return;const button=$('download-pdf'),result=structuredClone(state.result),lang=state.lang;
 button.disabled=true;button.classList.add('busy');button.textContent=TEXT[lang].pdfBusy;
 try{await new Promise(resolve=>requestAnimationFrame(resolve));const {bytes}=await createResultPDF(result,lang);const url=URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([bytes],{type:'application/pdf'}));const anchor=document.createElement('a');anchor.href=url;anchor.download=`Dazvol_${result.input.vehicle}_${result.timestamp.slice(0,10)}_${lang}.pdf`;document.body.append(anchor);anchor.click();anchor.remove();setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(url),60000)}catch(error){console.error('PDF export:',error);showToast('pdfError')}finally{button.disabled=false;button.classList.remove('busy');button.textContent='↓ '+TEXT[lang].pdf}
}
</script>
</body>
